INSTRUCTIONS: Copy this file, rename it, edit params.
Reference in a run file as: sensors/PAR/my_PAR

PARAM_DOCS.frequency_hz: Operating frequency in Hz. Default 9.0e9 (X-band) for PAR. High resolution needed for precision approach guidance, but severely affected by rain.
PARAM_DOCS.sector: [minAz, maxAz] pointing down runway. 170-190 = ±10deg of south.
PARAM_DOCS.rangeLimits: 20nm. Short range, high accuracy for final approach.
PARAM_DOCS.pd: 0.95 — high rate needed for precision guidance.

name: Precision Approach Radar
